dialogues.speaker: Yaoyao
dialogues.text: You look tired, do you need to take a rest?

dialogues.speaker: Yaoyao
dialogues.text: If you're feeling peckish, I've brought some Fried Radish Balls. I made them before we came here.

dialogues.speaker: Yaoyao
dialogues.text: Try to take life at a slower pace — it's good for your health!

dialogues.speaker: Yaoyao
dialogues.text: I sometimes have to face dangerous enemies when I'm out in the mountains gathering herbs. Like those greedy-gut Treasure Hoarders, or a boar in a bad mood.

dialogues.speaker: Yaoyao
dialogues.text: I know that not everywhere is gonna be as peaceful as the place where I grew up with my mom and dad. And Master won't always be there to protect me.

dialogues.speaker: Yaoyao
dialogues.text: That's why I practice the spear, even though I don't really like it. It's so I can drive those pesky varmints off all by myself!

dialogues.speaker: Yaoyao
dialogues.text: The kinds of books that adults read have so many complicated ideas in them. I can't wrap my head around them no matter how hard I try.

dialogues.speaker: Yaoyao
dialogues.text: Master says that there are many things I'll understand once I'm older.

dialogues.speaker: Yaoyao
dialogues.text: So does that mean that when you grow up, you understand the same things in a different way?
